justification: The rider has 106,718 rides with an average duration of 14.15 minutes. A monthly membership ($29) covers unlimited rides with no per-ride fees, as stated in the policy: "Members enjoy unlimited rides with no per-ride fees". Pay-per-ride would cost 106,718 * (14.15 * $0.17) = $256,644. The membership saves $256,515. The policy also states: "Free unlocks + $0.17/min" for pay-per-ride, but the membership is cheaper for high-frequency users.
assumptions: The whole file is treated as the trips of ONE rider (the file has no rider id).
A month is a calendar month that has at least one trip; a membership is bought for every such month.
Pay-per-use is charged as the single-ride price (or unlock fee) for every ride, plus the per-minute price for the minutes beyond the included minutes.
The weekly table uses SQLite weeks (%W, weeks start on Monday) and shows the first 12 weeks; spend is the pay-per-use cost.
No bike-type column (classic or electric), so every ride is treated as a classic bike.
All rides are within the 45-minute free tier of pay-per-ride
Average duration is representative of all rides
